questions.stem: In scalp anatomy, what do the letters of the SCALP mnemonic stand for?
questions.answer: Skin, connective tissue, aponeurosis, loose areolar tissue, pericranium

questions.stem: Which nerves of the ophthalmic division (V1) supply the forehead in a scalp block?
Which branch of the maxillary nerve (V2) supplies the temporal scalp in a scalp block?
Which branch of the mandibular nerve (V3) supplies the temporal scalp in a scalp block?
Which nerve supplies the lateral occipital scalp in a scalp block?
Which C2-3 nerve supplies the occipital scalp in a scalp block?
In a scalp block, where is the greater occipital nerve injected?
questions.answer: At the occipital protuberance, medial to the occipital artery

questions.stem: Where is the lesser occipital nerve blocked in a scalp block?
options: At the bridge of the nose

questions.stem: Where is the auriculotemporal nerve blocked in a scalp block?
options: At the bridge of the nose
At the tragus, behind the superficial temporal artery

questions.stem: Where is the supratrochlear nerve blocked in a scalp block?
options: At the bridge of the nose

questions.stem: Where is the supraorbital nerve blocked in a scalp block?
options: At the bridge of the nose

questions.stem: Where is the zygomaticotemporal nerve blocked in a scalp block?
options: At the bridge of the nose

questions.stem: Which cervical nerve roots does the optional greater auricular nerve branch from?
Which cervical nerves does the lesser occipital nerve branch from?
Which cervical nerve is the greater occipital nerve a branch of?
At what vertebral level does the greater occipital nerve arise?
In the individual nerve technique for scalp block, where do you inject the greater occipital nerve relative to the occipital artery?
options: Deep to the artery at the mastoid

questions.stem: In a scalp ring block, along which line are all the scalp nerves made reachable?
questions.answer: From the occipital protuberance to the eyebrows, along the upper border of the ear

questions.stem: How is local anaesthetic infiltrated along the line in a scalp ring block?
questions.answer: Circumferentially, with local anaesthetic plus 1:200,000 adrenaline

questions.stem: What volume of local anaesthetic does a scalp ring block need?
Which local anaesthetic mixture is used for a scalp block?
Which four nerves make up the anterior band in a scalp band block?
questions.answer: Supratrochlear, supraorbital, auriculotemporal and zygomaticotemporal nerves

questions.stem: Which two nerves make up the posterior band in a scalp band block?
In a scalp block, what type of block is the 7-injection individual nerve technique?
options: An anatomical block, not a ring block
A field block of the vertex

questions.stem: Which areas does the supraorbital nerve supply in a scalp block?
options: Forehead, anterior scalp and top of head

questions.stem: Which areas does the supratrochlear nerve supply in a scalp block?
Which area does the zygomaticotemporal nerve supply in a scalp block?
options: Small area of forehead and temple

questions.stem: Which areas does the auriculotemporal nerve supply in a scalp block?
options: Bridge of nose and upper eyelid
Temple, lower lip, lower face, auricle and nearby scalp

questions.stem: In the individual nerve technique for scalp block, where is the auriculotemporal nerve injected?
questions.answer: 1cm in front of and 1cm above the tragus, behind the superficial temporal artery

questions.stem: In an individual nerve scalp block, which injection usually also covers the greater auricular nerve?
Which needle gauge is used for a greater occipital nerve block, depending on patient size?
At what angle is the needle held to the occiput in a greater occipital nerve block?
After aspiration, what volume is injected in a greater occipital nerve block?
How far from the midline does the greater occipital nerve lie, between the protuberance and mastoid?
In a greater occipital nerve block, where along the protuberance-to-mastoid line does the lesser occipital nerve lie?
questions.answer: 1/3rd of the way along the same line

questions.stem: In the proximal ultrasound approach at C2, what is the greater occipital nerve's relation to obliquus capitis inferior?
questions.answer: Superficial to it, a constant relationship

questions.stem: In the proximal C2 ultrasound approach, how do you find obliquus capitis inferior?
questions.answer: Slide down from C1 to the C2 spinous process, then laterally

questions.stem: In a greater occipital nerve block, from which cervical root does the nerve arise?
